_comment: What a deployment is for, as data (Game/Mission/Objectives): each template a list of steps -- kind restore_power, download (the terminal worked while somebody stays at it), readings (each of the mission's markers worked) or carry (back to the shuttle) -- with the steps done before each (after), what the crew is told (text), a line under it while it is open (hint; hint_no_map when the briefing came without a map), what is shown while it is under way (working, with how far it has got; stay and paused under it, with somebody at it and with nobody), whether it is only there when the power is out (only_when_power_out) and whether the crew only learns of it on finding the terminal dead (learnt_at_terminal). A template also has what the briefing's screen lists (brief) and how the result is headed (done, failed). Which template a mission is laid from is its kind's: download_data, restore (a station), survey, signal, activate (a facility whose plant is to be started), revive (a signal gone silent, brought back). Read again when it changes while the game runs.

templates.name: Recover the data
brief: BRING THE DRIVE BACK TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Restore the power at the building's breaker board.
steps.hint: The terminal is dead until then.

steps.text: Download the data from the terminal.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.
steps.paused: Paused: nobody is at the terminal.

steps.text: Take the drive to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Restore the station
brief: RESTART LIFE SUPPORT AT THE CONTROL CONSOLE

steps.text: Restore the power at the station's breaker board.
steps.hint: Nothing in the station runs until then.

steps.text: Restart life support at the control console.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.
steps.paused: Paused: nobody is at the console.

steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Survey the site
brief: BRING THE READINGS BACK TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Take a reading at each of the survey markers.
steps.hint: Stand at a marker while its reading is taken.
steps.paused: Paused: nobody is at the marker.

steps.text: Take the readings back to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Trace the signal
brief: TRACE THE SIGNAL TO ITS SOURCE

steps.text: Find the transmitter and shut it down.
steps.paused: Paused: nobody is at the transmitter.

steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Start the plant
brief: RESTORE THE FACILITY'S POWER IF IT IS OUT
START ITS PLANT AT THE CONTROL CONSOLE

steps.text: Restore the power at the building's breaker board.
steps.hint: The console is dead until then.

steps.text: Start the plant at the control console, a system at a time.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.
steps.paused: Paused: nobody is at the console.

steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Bring the signal back
brief: FIND THE TRANSMITTER THAT HAS GONE SILENT
BRING IT BACK ON THE AIR

steps.text: Find the silent transmitter and bring it back on the air.
steps.hint: The tracker has its last known position.
steps.paused: Paused: nobody is at the transmitter.

steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.
